$comment: A per-branch PREVIEW of the staging frontend must talk to the SAME branch's backend preview, so
that a physical UAT certifies one candidate end-to-end. The first Phase 8 physical UAT did not:
the preview frontend fell back to the stable staging backend (which serves `main`), so every
backend-dependent step measured `main`'s contract while appearing to certify PR #165.
Keys are git branch refs (VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_REF). Values are the ORIGIN of that branch's backend
preview — Vercel's stable per-branch alias, which keeps its hostname across redeploys of the
branch. `/api` is appended by the API client, so record the bare origin here.
A branch absent from this map builds FAIL-CLOSED: its preview resolves to a reserved `.invalid`
host and cannot reach any real backend. That is deliberate — an unpaired preview must fail loudly
rather than silently borrow another candidate's backend.
An explicit VITE_API_URL in the environment always wins over this file.
